name: Spirits Of Nature
overview: Scripture warns believers to avoid engaging with familiar spirits or seeking wizards, as such practices defile and oppose God's holiness (Leviticus 19:31). Instead, Christians are called to walk in the Spirit, which enables them to resist the desires of the flesh. The conflict between the flesh and the Spirit is real and ongoing, highlighting the necessity of reliance on the Holy Spirit to live in obedience and resist ungodly influences (Galatians 5:16-17).
